title: feat(spec)!: PROTOCOL_VERSION 18 → 19, and every current-protocol handshake reads '^19'
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpEsWWE9Y5YtSsDgqZ Fixes #37229 Clause-②: yes (narrowing) Metadata-protocol: narrowed Skills-docs: follow-up #37298 ## 维护者速读 - 协议版本从 18 升到 19:仓库里每个示例应用、连接器应用和文档示例都改为声明 19,新建项目模板在出预发布版时自动改成 19;只有装 19 预发布版的人会碰到。 - 属于「19.0.0 大版本」路线(你选的方案「A」第 2 项);它解开 19.0.0-next 的版本 PR:出版本的流水线不接受顺手改协议版本,所以由这一单先改好。 - 装了 19 预发布版、但应用仍声明 18 的人,启动时会被拒绝并提示改成 19(单一配置文件的应用有一条命令可自动改;多包组合的应用要逐个包手改);18.x 正式版用户不受影响;撤回即还原本单。 - 按你对冲突的裁决「A」,本单还改了一道检查:预发布模式下且 spec 已排定大版本时,下架提示写「19.0.0」不再被拦;五条下架提示因此写 19.0.0。 - 要你做的:「进入预发布模式」那一单已合并;本单是大版本变更,请你亲自把关合并。「Check Changeset」是有意的红:本单改了别人已合并的两条变更说明(各改一处事实)。另一单 #37298 改三个技能文件,在本单合入之后合并。 ## What changes On the shape of the v18 move (#22215, commit `4e9fe9f`), minus `skills/**`. - **`packages/spec/src/kernel/protocol-version.ts`:** `PROTOCOL_VERSION = '19.0.0'`. The docblock names protocol 19 as the pre-mode lockstep exception (ruling records 6049734955 and 7153441862), and says the blank template follows at the version pass and the published skills' examples in a change of their own. - **Handshakes:** 85 sites in 67 files move `engines.protocol` from `'^18'` to `'^19'`. Each is a manifest that stands for "an app on the current protocol", and none of them asserts on the range. | Directory | Files | Sites | |---|---|---| | `examples/` (crm, showcase, todo, starter, multi-package ×2) | 6 | 6 | | `packages/apps/connector-{docusign,github,stripe}` | 3 | 3 | | `packages/cli` (tests) | 40 | 56 | | `packages/qa` (7 dogfood tests, the sql-perf bench app, the scenarios exporter test) | 9 | 9 | | `packages/lint`, `packages/spec`, `packages/metadata` (tests) | 4 | 5 | | `packages/mcp/README.md` | 1 | 2 | | `content/docs` (cli, your-first-project, upgrading) | 3 | 3 | | `docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.json` | 1 | 1 | `examples/app-starter` arrived from `main` (#37399) declaring `'^18'` and moves with the merge. Its boot test, which installs the starter through `MarketplaceInstallLocalPlugin`, passes 5/5 at `'^19'`. At `'^18'` it reads 3 failed | 2 passed, refused `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE`. - **`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json`:** one prose fact, "the stock showcase declares `'^18'`", now reads `'^19'`. - **`docs/qa/scenarios/builds/travel_expense.provenance.json`:** `sha256` is the build's hash as it now stands, and a second `amended` entry names the one edit (`engines.protocol` `'^18'` → `'^19'`) and the hash it replaced. `cardSha256` is unchanged. - **The protocol 19 migration step (ADR-0087).** `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template` opens `step19`, with no conversions yet. Its first semantic entry, `entries/semantic/19.protocol-18-range-refused.ts`, is the refusal this PR causes, with the prescription: `--write` rewrites the range of a root `defineStack` manifest; for a manifest `composeStacks` composes, it writes nothing and lists the range for a hand edit in each package manifest. Its acceptance text claims only what the hop does: it edits or refuses the range. A key retired in this release that the metadata still carries is refused at parse by its own message, which names its own remedy. The text no longer says that `validate` passes or that every package installs. The upgrade guide now generates three hop sections (17, 18, 19). See "Why a step-19 entry" below. - **Removal prescriptions stamped after 18.6.0 name `@objectstack/spec 19.0.0`.** `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` derives the removing release's major from `PROTOCOL_MAJOR`, so at 19 the retirements not in the published 18.6.0 name 19.0.0, not 18.7.0, a release the v19 line never cuts: `object-grid` `singleClickEdit` (`component.zod.ts`), the boolean `field.inlineEdit` (`field.zod.ts`), `listView.columnState` and `view.columnState` (`view.zod.ts`), and `seed.mode` `'insert'` / `'replace'` (`seed.zod.ts`). Their text pins, the regenerated `content/docs/references/ui/{component,view}.mdx`, `content/docs/data-modeling/seed-data.mdx` and the metadata-protocol seed pin follow. - **`scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs` reads the pre-mode window (ruling record 7176929521, option A).** On a stable `@objectstack/spec` label, with `.changeset/pre.json` at `"mode": "pre"` and a pending changeset declaring `"@objectstack/spec": major`, the next publish is label + 1, so the gate judges citations against 19 here. That is why the prescriptions above can name `@objectstack/spec 19.0.0`. The window is read through `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`'s `readProtocolLockstepInputs`, the reader the protocol lockstep already uses; there is no second parser. That file's docblock now names its three importers (`check-docs-image-tag.mjs`, `check-future-spec-major.mjs`, `pm/l1-face.mjs`); the change is a comment. Label + 2, pre mode without a pending spec major, a pending spec major outside pre mode and a prerelease label each open nothing; five new self-test rows pin those five cases (34 → 39 cases). An unreadable `.changeset/` opens nothing either, by the code; no row pins it. The stable-label condition is the same one `judgeProtocolLockstep` applies: on a `19.0.0-next.N` label the label's own major is already the carrier. Reverse verification: with the window condition ablated, the gate reads 14 problems, the 14 sites. - **Two fixtures pay a dynamic load at module top** (`validate-flow-region-shape.test.ts`, `plugin-artifact-packages-attribution.test.ts`). `check:test-source-alias` judges every test file a diff edits, and both edits here are the range literal. The gate prescribes exactly these imports. - **`.changeset/37229-protocol-19.md`:** `"@objectstack/spec": minor` and `"@objectstack/mcp": patch` (its shipped `README.md` changes), the two declaration lines, a BREAKING note with the FROM → TO and the command, and `registered protocol-18-range-refused`. - **DELIBERATE CORRECTION of two existing changesets.** `Check Changeset` stays red on both by design: each note is on the merge base, and each changes only the facts this PR makes false. - `.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md` (carried N1 of #37230's L1, and N3 of this PR's L1), two sentences. "The first is `@object-ui/i18n`'s retirement …" now reads "The first change graded `major` is `@object-ui/i18n`'s retirement …", because this PR's protocol move is a breaking change graded `minor`. "`PROTOCOL_VERSION` follows `@objectstack/spec`'s major at version time." now reads "`PROTOCOL_VERSION` moves to 19 ahead of the version pass, in its own changeset." - `.changeset/37042-skills-inline-edit-boolean.md`, one clause: "The spec parse refuses `true` and `false` on a relationship field's `inlineEdit` since 18.7.0" now reads "… since 19.0.0", the release the retirement ships in. - **Carried from #37230's L1, N3 — `ui/packages/i18n/scripts/released-keys-removed.mjs`** refuses an argument it does not know (exit 2, naming it), and prints the tag's commit: `^{commit}` peels the annotated tag. Measured: the tag `@object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` is a tag object `0dbef86ce3`, and the script now prints its commit `958ee03594`. The script is not in the package's `files[]`, so it publishes nothing and needs no changeset. ## Judgments: every `'^18'` left in place, with its reason | Site | Reason | |---|---| | `skills/**` (3 files) | Governed Tier H; the sibling PR #37298. | | `packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.config.ts:38` | The version pass stamps it with the template's `@objectstack/*` versions, and `template-consistency.test.ts` holds it equal to the scaffolder major (create-objectstack is 18.6.0). Measured: moved to `'^19'` now, that test goes red; the version-pass rehearsal below stamps it `'^19'`. Same judgment as #22215. | | `packages/cli/src/utils/protocol-version-gap.test.ts:82` | Paired with an explicit installed `'17.2.0'`: "a newer major is silent". The subject is the pairing, not the current protocol. | | `packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion*.test.ts`, `protocol-handshake.test.ts` | The subject is the artifact's floor against an injected runtime label (the v18 prerelease major-step window), or a range/major pair. No handshake against `PROTOCOL_VERSION` runs. | | `packages/metadata/src/plugin-artifact-forward-conversion-{major-step,package-body}.test.ts` | The same age subject at the metadata door, which runs no handshake. | | `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/platform-core.json`, item `platform-core.protocol-18-handshake-and-stored-replay` | Revised in place to protocol 19 (revision 6, with its history entry). The id keeps its protocol-18 slug because ids are immutable. Its `'^18'` now stands for the refused case: `'^18'` → 422 `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE` naming `os migrate meta --from 18`, `'^19'` admitted, and the artifact step edits the copy's range to `'>=18.0.0'`, as the option-B fixture does. | | `content/docs/releases/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `**/CHANGELOG.md`, `.github/workflows/release.yml` (comment), script comments | Release-owned, governed or historical prose. | | `ui/**` tests, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages-ensure-customization.test.ts`, `scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs` | Not a protocol handshake (`requiredRange` of a later refusal, a package-dependency range, a React peer range). | Moved to `'>=18.0.0'` (5 sites, commit `e05fdf6f`): `packages/runtime/src/standalone-stack-option-b-forward-conversion.test.ts`. It boots through the load seam, which refuses `'^18'` at protocol 19. Measured: `ProtocolIncompatibleError: package 'com.test.ob.core' targets protocol ^18 … Run: objectstack migrate meta --from 18`, 3 cases. Its subject is the conversion window, which opens on the floor. `'>=18.0.0'` keeps the floor (18.0.0, as `parseRangeFloor` reads `^18`) and admits 19. This is the same move as #22215's two runtime fixtures (`>=17.1.0`). The fixture's docblock now says why, so a later sweep to `'^19'` does not close the window. ## Why a step-19 entry (the ADR-0087 disposition) `Metadata-protocol:` is judged from content. A 19 runtime refuses an authored value, `engines.protocol: '^18'`, that 18 admitted. That is `narrowed`, and the `Clause-②` arm is `narrowing`, as in #22215. On a declared `narrowed`, `check:adr-0087-registration` refuses `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` outright and asks for a registered entry. Measured: "`not-required (no-migration-prescription)` is refused on a changeset that declares `Metadata-protocol: narrowed` … fix: register an entry under packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/". No entry at the merge base covers the refusal, so this PR opens step 19 with one entry, and the upgrade guide carries the prescription. ## Acceptance notes - **Docs versus npm `latest`.** The three docs pages show `'^19'`, as in #22215. npm `latest` stays 18.6.0 until 19.0 GA, and an 18.x runtime refuses `'^19'`. The changeset says to move the range together with the `@objectstack/*` versions. - **Size.** 92 files, +440 / −161 against `main` (GitHub at `3811cd10f5a`), under the 3,000-line threshold. - **Out of this PR, found by the version-pass rehearsal.** On the post-version tree, `check:release-notes` is red: `@objectstack/spec` ships 19.x and there is no curated `content/docs/releases/v19` page. It is red on the control leg too (main + #37230, without this PR), so #37230's `major` causes it, not this PR. Release pages are release-owned, so this PR does not write one. Until one exists, the version-PR lane still refuses the 19.0.0-next refresh, on that gate alone. - **#37287 and step 19.** #37287 registered its retirement, `KnowledgeChunk.metadata`, under step 18; it reached this branch through the merge of `main`, and its refusal says "removed in @objectstack/spec 18" (`packages/spec/src/ai/knowledge-document.zod.ts:61`). Once protocol 19 is on `main`, `os migrate meta --from 18` replays only step 19, so a retirement that ships on the v19 line and is filed under step 18 is not listed to an 18 → 19 upgrader. #37287 is one member of the family "step-18 entries registered on `main` after the 18.6.0 tag" (31 step-18 semantic entry files at this head that the 18.6.0 tag does not carry, and 34 on `main` at `5d21d431ec`, after #37382, #37392 and #37395). That card is follow-up owed (seat). - **The dev's open questions, as built (seat reading at L1):** - The declaration is `yes (narrowing)` + `narrowed` with a step-19 entry, rather than `semantic`. - The blank template stays `'^18'`, and the version pass stamps it. - The metadata and metadata-core floor-subject sites are kept. The option-B runtime file moves to `'>=18.0.0'`. - The gate conflict between `check-future-spec-major` and the removal-version pin is resolved by ruling record 7176929521, option A (above). ## Verification Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs` prints `✓ check-future-spec-major: no @objectstack/spec citation names a major above 19` and `pre-mode window: label major 18, pre mode next, pending major for @objectstack/spec in .changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md — the next publish carries 19`, and exits 0. `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main` prints `✓ Protocol lockstep: PROTOCOL_VERSION major 19, @objectstack/spec@18.6.0 — the one exception, evidenced: pre mode (tag next) and a pending major for @objectstack/spec (.changeset/37223-v19-line-opens.md).` and exits 0. Read first: 1. `.changeset/37229-protocol-19.md` and `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.protocol-18-range-refused.ts`: what an upgrading author is told. 2. `packages/spec/src/migrations/registry.ts.template`, the new `step19`: the ledger's protocol 19 step opens here. 3. `scripts/check-future-spec-major.mjs`, `judgedMajor` and the five new self-test rows: the one gate this PR changes. 4. The Judgments table: every `'^18'` left in place.
Readings at 3811cd10f5a (the dev's, through the verify lock, and the seat's L1) - **CI at `3811cd10f5a`:** 70 check-runs, 60 success, 9 skipped, 1 failure. The failure is `Check Changeset`, by design: its two file annotations name the two DELIBERATE CORRECTION notes, and its ADR-0087 and no-major steps are green. All eleven required contexts are success, `Test Core` 10/10 included, and so is `Type Check · source gates`. - **Tests:** - dogfood full battery (os-dev-report 7183121949 on #37229): Test Files 487 passed | 3 skipped (490), Tests 4129 passed | 68 skipped (4197), VERDICT command-exit 0. - whole spec suite: Test Files 896 passed (896), Tests 28442 passed | 1 todo (28443). - `examples/app-starter` boot test: 5/5 (re-run by the seat). With the range put back to `'^18'` through `ablation-replace`, it reads 3 failed | 2 passed, refused `OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE`; the restore was proven with `git diff HEAD` empty. - `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` and `protocol-version.test.ts`: 2 files, 68/68 (re-run by the seat). - **Guards:** - `check-future-spec-major` exits 0, and `--self-test` reads `39 cases pass` (re-run by the seat). The gate file is byte-identical to `9ed0f5e41f6`, where the seat ablated `stable`, the pending-major condition, the pre-mode condition and `+ 1` in turn: one self-test row went red each time, and with the window off the scan read the 14 sites. Each ablation was restored with `git diff HEAD` empty. - `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main` exits 0. - `check:adr-0087-registration` exits 0 with `registered protocol-18-range-refused`. - `dispatch-gates --commands` derives 150 families on this diff. Two are red: `check-empty-changeset` by design (the two DELIBERATE CORRECTION notes), and `check:platform-checklist` on `areas/automation.json: ABSENT SYMBOL … FlowItemMoreMenu.tsx#FlowItemMoreMenu`, which `main` itself carries (reproduced on `origin/main` `ecbe854bda`; this diff touches neither path). The other 148 exit 0. - **Against current `main` (`5d21d431ec`, 9 commits past the merge base):** `git merge-tree --write-tree` is clean, and the merged tree carries the same `'^18'` lines as this head. `main` added no other handshake at `'^18'`.
Earlier readings (the dev's, on 9da4c1d4 plus the fixture fix, and at 8852bcb for the --write reach) Not re-run at `3811cd10f5a`. Of the code these read, this PR changed only the step-19 entry's text and the `examples/app-starter` range after them. The merges of `main` brought other changes in, and CI at the head is green. - **Handshake**, from the built `@objectstack/metadata-core` on protocol 19: `'^18'` → `incompatible OS_PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE … Run: objectstack migrate meta --from 18`; `'^19'` → `ok`. - **Prescription**, with the built CLI. On a `'^18'` copy of `examples/app-todo`, `os migrate meta --from 18` lists the step-19 entry, and `--write` rewrites `objectstack.config.ts:48` to `'^19'`. On `examples/app-multi-package` with both package manifests at `'^18'`, `--write` writes nothing and prints the range for a hand edit (`manifest is composed by composeStacks(…)`). - **Template control leg:** moving the blank template to `'^19'` now turns `template-consistency.test.ts` red (`expected 19 to be 18`). - **`release.yml` version-pass rehearsal.** The `version-pr` Render and Validate blocks were extracted verbatim and run in a throwaway clone: - Results: `PROTOCOL_VERSION already 19.0.0`; the template is stamped `'^19'`; unvalidated surfaces 0; 14 of 15 content gates green; `check:release-notes` red. - Control (main + #37230 without this PR): `protocol-version.ts` is unvalidated, with the same release-notes red. - **Tests:** cli 677 files, 8441 tests passed; runtime 647 files, 11978 passed | 25 skipped (the option-B file fails 3 cases at 9da4c1d4 and passes 6/6 at e05fdf6f); metadata, metadata-core, lint, mcp, create-objectstack, scenarios and the example tests all green; `validate` exits 0 for 4 examples and 3 connector apps.
## Provenance Opened by seat repo:objectstack#4 on the maintainer's authorization in the seat session (「#37229 的两个 PR 开 PR 时被拦了：放行」). The dev session (`session_01QSeKYnLptCbfzwtkTrDG3j`, zone a4-S) had three writes refused by its permission check, and none was retried: its relay `pr_create`, the hand-off of the payload to the seat, and the push of the runtime fixture fix. The seat read the prepared body from that session's final message. The fixture fix was then re-applied and pushed as `e05fdf6f` (fast-forward, five sites in one test file) by a seat-dispatched dev, on the maintainer's authorization 「#37229 夹具修复推送放行」. Rework round 1 (seat L1 7170046632) pushed `3fdf3490b9` to `43133e8ce5`. After ruling record 7176929521, `c871272e47` merged `origin/main` `db77cc493a`, `e5a7e35bff` regenerated the two ui reference pages from the merged tree, and `9ed0f5e41f` changed the gate. Rework round 2 (seat L1 7181615974, L2 7181629335): `d47c169db75` merged `origin/main` `da7c559990`, and `3811cd10f5a` moved `examples/app-starter` to `'^19'`, narrowed the step-19 entry's acceptance text, and corrected a comment in `check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
